name: flacsync
description: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer ve YouTube Music linklerinden ya da şarkı adından doğru kaydı bulup etiketli MP3/FLAC olarak kaydeden açık kaynak uygulama

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w frontend && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w frontend && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
